name: aipet
description: Shows each Codex chat's status on the AiPet desktop pet, and lets Codex drive the pet through its MCP server. Needs the AiPet app running; does nothing otherwise.

interface.shortDescription: Show your Codex chats on the AiPet desktop pet
interface.longDescription: A floating pixel pet that mirrors your chats. The hooks only observe: they report each event to the pet's MCP server, print nothing to Codex and do nothing while the pet is closed. Codex can also use the pet's tools to wear a pet, change its sizes, or save a theme.
